reviews.author: Ilene C…
reviews.body: Every time I come in, I leave feeling like a brand new woman 🙂‍↔️ The tan lines are always sharp & the products Raini uses smell so good! One of my favorite parts of the experience is receiving the small bottle of juice that she freshly makes. It is delicious! If I could buy a jug to-go, I would 🤭 Having a shower in the same room as the tanning stall is such a luxury that you don’t find anywhere. I love being able to rinse off the product right on the spot. Try out this service, you won’t regret it!
